title: Media viewer
summary: Full-screen view of the photos and videos of a chat, starting at the one tapped. Swipe for the others, pinch to zoom, play video, save, share, reply or delete.

of.description: A timeline item id of an image or video.

items.description: The images and videos of the loaded timeline, oldest first. Swiping past the first back-paginates.

senderName.description: Shown on top with the time.

phase.description: Full-size download of the current item.

chromeVisible.description: A tap shows or hides the bars.

load.effect: Client.getMediaContent for images and Client.getMediaFile for videos at full size; the thumbnail shows until then.

swipe.effect: Shows that item and loads it.

save.effect: Saves to the photo library (asks for add-only permission on iOS). Shows bipe_app_media_saved or bipe_app_media_save_failed.

share.effect: The system share sheet with the decrypted file.

reply.effect: Closes and starts message-reply for the item.

delete.effect: Own item: message-delete confirm; on delete, closes or moves to the next.

close.effect: Closes, also with a swipe down.

notes: Saved and shared files leave the encryption: they are plain files on the phone. No text needed; the action is the person's choice.
The per-chat media list (bipe_dm_media_empty, chat info) is groups and DMs work (bipe-chat/bipe#569).
